card.name: Inside split words and formats
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered tokens that sit inside a longer word, label, or code string, such as a % in a date format or the De of Debye.
card.plain: It reacts to scattered pieces in the middle of compound words, tables and code, with no pattern a reader could rely on.
